theme_and_archetype.client_portal_theme: Light Mode (clean, data-focused, high legibility for documents and dashboards)
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The brand's core identity revolves around deep navy and electric blue. For a software engineering firm, a dark mode marketing site commands authority and technical expertise. The client portal and admin panel must switch to a clean, high-contrast light theme to maximize readability for PDFs, data tables, and client accounts.

project_context.language: French (ALL UI elements, content, placeholders, and buttons MUST be in French)

typography.font_strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applied. No Inter or Roboto.

headings.usage: Provides a distinctive, technical, and modern software engineering aesthetic.

body.usage: Extremely clean and functional for heavy data grids, documentation, and paragraphs.

layout_and_spacing.marketing_spacing: Generous (p-8, p-12, py-24). Using bento grid layouts and overlapping asymmetric structures to avoid the standard template look.
layout_and_spacing.portal_spacing: Control Room Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4, gap-6) utilizing full width and height to maximize data density.
layout_and_spacing.responsive_rules: Mobile-first approach. grid-cols-1 on mobile, scaling up to md:grid-cols-2 or lg:grid-cols-12 based on the mode.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle roundness: rounded-lg (8px) for buttons and cards. Avoid excessive pill-shapes.

surface_strategies.marketing_header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#081226]/60 border-b border-white/10). Sticky z-50.
surface_strategies.marketing_cards: The Tracing Beam/Subtle Glow. Dark surfaces with 1px border border-[#1E90FF]/20 and subtle hover lift.
surface_strategies.portal_dashboard: Grid Borders and clean white surfaces. Use flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders (border-border) rather than heavy drop shadows.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have visible hover states. E.g., hover:bg-[#2BA4FF] hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion staggered list entrances (0.1s delay per item).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Smooth reveal for marketing sections (translate-y-4 opacity-0 to translate-y-0 opacity-100 on scroll).

component_guidelines.icons: lucide-react (Standard choice) for portal; can mix in phosphor-icons for marketing sections.
component_guidelines.ui_library_portal: Shadcn/UI heavily utilized for the client portal (Data Table, Tabs, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Calendar, Select). Override default radii to match brand (rounded-lg).
component_guidelines.ui_library_marketing: Custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing. Avoid strict Shadcn cards to allow creative asymmetrical bento layouts.
component_guidelines.forms_and_auth: Use Shadcn Input, Form, and Checkbox. The login flow MUST include an OTP input (use Shadcn Input-OTP) and space for a reCAPTCHA widget.
component_guidelines.testing_requirements: All interactive/informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

marketing_public.Hero_Accueil: Full viewport height. Tech network background image overlaid with bg-[#081226]/70. Bold H1 heading, primary CTA (Demander un RDV), and secondary CTA (Espace Client).
marketing_public.Missions_Experience: Bento grid layout highlighting company metrics, years of experience, and core software engineering values.
marketing_public.Specialisations_Catalogue: Grid of services (Web, Mobile, AI, Systems). Interactive cards with hover effects revealing more details.
marketing_public.Contact_RDV: Split layout. Left: Contact info and address. Right: Formularie de contact and RDV request with Shadcn Calendar integration.

client_portal.Auth_Flow: Split screen. Left: Abstract software architecture background with logo. Right: Login form -> reCAPTCHA -> OTP verification step.
client_portal.Dashboard_Etat: Top-level KPI widgets (Account status, active projects). Sidebar navigation.
client_portal.RDV_Management: Calendar view displaying availability. Form to request/book a meeting.
client_portal.Documentation: Data table listing available software documentation (PDFs) with 'Download' or 'View' actions.
client_portal.Historique_Interventions: Detailed Shadcn Data Table showing past interventions, status, and assigned users.

admin_panel.Gestion_Clients: CRUD interface for managing client accounts. Table with search and pagination.
admin_panel.Upload_Contenus: Form for admins to upload PDFs/Docs with Rich Text editor for announcements.
admin_panel.Parametres: Forms for Google Calendar credentials, reCAPTCHA keys, and SMTP configs.

logo.description: SAWALI SMART SYSTEMS Official Logo (Deep Navy, Electric Blue, White)
logo.usage: Main navigation, footer, and Auth screen left panel.

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D network lines and glowing nodes, electric blue glowing on deep navy blue background
hero_background.usage: Background image for the public Hero section. MUST apply heavy dark overlay to ensure text readability.

auth_background.description: Minimalist geometric software architecture, deep navy and cyan lighting
auth_background.usage: Background image for the left side of the authentication screen (Login/OTP portal).

office_culture.usage: Use in the 'Experience' or 'About' section of the marketing site.

software_code.description: Colorful lines of code on a computer screen
software_code.usage: Use in the 'Spécialisations' or 'Catalogue' sections as a visual anchor.

instructions_to_main_agent: ALL UI text must be in French.
Implement Space Grotesk for headings and Geist for body text.
Ensure perfect transition between the Dark Theme (marketing side) and Light Theme (portal/admin side).
Use exact hex codes provided in color_palette. Apply electric blue as the primary interaction color.
Do not use generic placeholder images; rely strictly on the media_urls provided.
Enforce responsive design across all views. Ensure the client portal's sidebar is fully collapsible on mobile.
Implement robust data-testid attributes for every actionable element.
Use Shadcn UI for the portal's data density but stick to custom Tailwind classes for the marketing site to preserve creative freedom.
